headline: Pro Football Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri to Kick off the Patriots Countdown to Munich by Attempting a Guinness World Record on the Jungfraujoch
summary: The Patriots are joining forces with Jungfrau Railways to promote this year’s game in Munich with a kickoff event in the Swiss Alps in the DACH region. Pro Football Hall of Fame placekicker Adam Vinatieri will attempt an official Guinness World Records kick at Jungfraujoch, a resort known as the Top of Europe in the Swiss Alps.
